name: Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad 拟以277万令吉向 Hextar Holdings 出售其全资子公司 Guper Bonded Warehouse 的100%股权，从而退出保税仓储业务；同时，其子公司 Pengangkutan Sekata 于2026年1月完成一项先前公布的处置。此外，公司终止了 Nilai 工业用地出售及 KIP REIT 仓储物业出售两项交易。
overview_en: In 2026, Hextar Technologies Solutions Berhad proposed to dispose of its entire 100% equity interest in wholly-owned subsidiary Guper Bonded Warehouse to Hextar Holdings for RM2.77 million, exiting the bonded warehousing business; meanwhile, its subsidiary Pengangkutan Sekata completed a previously announced disposal in January 2026. In addition, the company terminated both the proposed disposal of industrial land in Nilai and the proposed sale of a warehousing property to KIP REIT.

segments.name: 仓储
segments.note: 拟出售全资子公司 Guper Bonded Warehouse，退出保税仓储业务；另有一项仓储物业出售予 KIP REIT 的交易已终止。
segments.note_en: Proposed to dispose of wholly-owned subsidiary Guper Bonded Warehouse, exiting the bonded warehousing business; a separate sale of a warehousing property to KIP REIT was terminated.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED DISPOSAL BY HEXTAR TECHNOLOGIES SOLUTIONS BERHAD ("HEXTECH" OR THE "COMPANY") OF ITS EN
actions.text: 向股东发出有关出售 Guper Bonded Warehouse 100%股权的通函。
actions.text_en: Issued a circular to shareholders in relation to the proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in Guper Bonded Warehouse.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Hextar Holdings 签订有条件股份买卖协议，以277万令吉现金出售 Guper Bonded Warehouse 100%股权。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional share sale agreement with Hextar Holdings to dispose of 100% equity interest in Guper Bonded Warehouse for a cash consideration of RM2.77 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 因部分先决条件未在约定时间内达成，Channel Legion 与 KIP REIT 双方同意终止仓储物业买卖协议。
actions.text_en: Channel Legion and KIP REIT mutually agreed to terminate the sale and purchase agreement for the warehousing property due to non-fulfilment of certain conditions precedent within the agreed timeframe.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 将 Channel Legion 与 KIP REIT 之间仓储物业买卖协议的條件期限延长三个月至2026年5月28日。
actions.text_en: Extended the conditional period of the sale and purchase agreement between Channel Legion and KIP REIT for the warehousing property by three months to 28 May 2026.

segments.name: 物流
segments.note: 子公司 Pengangkutan Sekata 完成一项先前公布的处置。
segments.note_en: Subsidiary Pengangkutan Sekata completed a previously announced disposal.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Pengangkutan Sekata 与 Airique Property 的买卖协议于2026年1月5日完成。
actions.text_en: The sale and purchase agreement between wholly-owned subsidiary Pengangkutan Sekata and Airique Property was completed on 5 January 2026.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 终止 Nilai 工业用地出售交易。
segments.note_en: Terminated the proposed disposal of industrial land in Nilai.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Guper Bonded Warehouse 与 Widad Development (Nilai) 双方同意终止位于 Negeri Sembilan Nilai 的四块相邻永久工业用地出售交易。
actions.text_en: Guper Bonded Warehouse and Widad Development (Nilai) mutually agreed to terminate the proposed disposal of four adjoining freehold industrial land parcels in Nilai, Negeri Sembilan.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟出售 Guper Bonded Warehouse 全部股权，退出保税仓储业务。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to dispose of the entire equity interest in Guper Bonded Warehouse, exiting the bonded warehousing business.
